rationale: Prospective policy for fresh protected confirmation after the frozen Phase178 and postscore audits.
Each scenario-readout cell keeps its own frozen DESN control and tau0; no universal specification is selected.
Five unresolved exQDESN scenario-readout cells enter the post-Phase178 decision.
The frozen current-grid numerical minima contain three nonparity challengers and two parity selections.
Selected plus parity controls deduplicate to eight templates across the five cells.
Three previously protected and unused confirmation DGP replicates are available per base scenario.
Eight case-specific templates times three protected replicates.
Twenty-four candidate-replicate cases times sixteen independent chains.
DGP-integrated expected finite-grid quantile score is the prospective selection metric.
Choose the smallest finite score independently within each case and break exact ties deterministically by template id.
Any strictly positive score gain may advance; the earlier half-percent practical margin remains historical only.
Fresh confirmation requires the selected challenger to improve on at least two of three matched replicates.
Posterior lower-score probabilities and intervals are reported but are not a superiority gate under the user-directed any-gain policy.
Median fit and forecast oracle-path error ratios may not degrade materially relative to parity.
No protected replicate may show more than ten-percent oracle-path degradation.
Only clearly unstable score functionals are promotion-blocking; the preferred 1.05 threshold remains a review diagnostic.
Extremely low score-functional bulk ESS blocks promotion while moderate mixing limitations remain review evidence.
Extremely low score-functional tail ESS blocks promotion while moderate mixing limitations remain review evidence.
Score rank R-hat above 1.05 is reported as review evidence.
Score bulk ESS below 400 is reported as review evidence.
Score tail ESS below 200 is reported as review evidence.
Raw draw crossing rates above one percent remain visible review evidence.
Reported monotone-contract quantile paths must not cross.
All confirmation draws use the promoted exact-M0 exAL method.
Sixteen chains improve functional precision and permit robust chain-allocation diagnostics.
Confirmation chain length inherited from the frozen Phase178 compute policy.
Confirmation burn-in inherited from the frozen Phase178 compute policy.
Confirmation thinning inherited from the frozen Phase178 compute policy.
Chain-balanced score reconstruction spans the retained chain while bounding post-processing cost.
Independent quantile posteriors use the previously frozen product-posterior coupling seed.
Only the previously frozen and uninspected confirmation DGP seeds may be used.
No pre-M0 sampler result may enter the confirmation.
Article fixtures remain excluded from selection and protected confirmation.
The seven-level current grid remains fixed; dense-grid fitting is a later separate campaign.
A challenger is promoted when fresh protected evidence shows any positive score gain and all hard safeguards pass.
Promotion is always per case and never defines one DESN or tau0 specification for all scenarios.
